node.title: XR rank-two actual block extensions have an exact zero-set count
node.statement: For a fixed rank-two support S_i and slope, polynomial division by the inactive extension locator splits the h block checks into d+1-z_i support-local and tau_i extension-sensitive checks. The selected trade row pays one local check, leaving exactly h-1. The local checks give a unique degree-<a correction w_i; actual blocks are exactly the tau_i-subsets of the external zero set of b+gamma_i q+w_i and are counted by C(|E_i|,tau_i). Family compatibility, first-core ownership, and cross-core payment remain open.
